# Orion Love, Real Estate Broker (Grand Junction, Colorado)

> Orion Love is a real estate broker with Keller Williams Colorado West Realty who works with home sellers in Grand Junction and across Mesa County, Colorado. Colorado Associate Broker License #FA.100110841.

- Brokerage: Keller Williams Colorado West Realty
- Office: 2474 Patterson Rd #100, Grand Junction, CO 81505
- Phone: (970) 644-6781
- Email: orion.love.co@gmail.com
- Service area: Grand Junction, Fruita, Palisade, Clifton, the Redlands, Orchard Mesa, Loma, Mack and the rest of Mesa County, Colorado
- Focus: seller representation (pricing, preparation, listing and negotiation); buyer conversations are also welcome
- Background: born in Delta, Colorado; living in the Grand Valley since 2010; nearly ten years building custom cabinetry before real estate
- Membership: National Association of Realtors (Orion is a Realtor)

## How Orion works with sellers

- The first meeting is a walk-through of the house, room by room: what to fix and what to leave alone
- Orion brings the recent sales and current listings a buyer would compare the home to, so the seller leaves the first meeting with a price range and the reasoning behind it
- While a home is listed, sellers get an update every Friday: showings, online saves, agent feedback and whether the price or plan should change
- Orion replies to messages and value-review requests within one business day; there is no obligation to list
